query:
INSERT INTO entity_aliases (user_id, entity_type, name, entity_id)
            SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4
            WHERE EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM entities e WHERE e.id = $4 AND e.user_id = $1
            )
            ON CONFLICT (user_id, entity_type, name) DO UPDATE SET entity_id = EXCLUDED.entity_id
